integrity: The claim follows from conditional-entropy disintegration and an all-sequence marker-packing inequality; enumerated finite tests are supplementary, not substitutes for infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the stated binary locally constant channel family; no unrestricted classification of finite-memory Ruelle channels or mutual-information capacity is claimed. The unique invariant maximizing input is a periodic orbit measure. Earlier equivalent examples may exist outside inspected sources.
title: Near-maximal stationary–nonstationary entropy separation in binary Ruelle channels
